title: Head 8 · Evaluation

Head 8 · Evaluation: scoring the pipeline on Ego4D

sections.title: Summary
blocks: Our own test clips are few and mostly labelled by the AI assistant. To get an outside score, the pipeline was run on **Ego4D episodic memory**: head-camera video with labels made by other people for three of Eykon's questions:

rows: VQ (photo of an object → last time seen)
When did I last see this?
Object crops and the 0.87 same-object rule (Head 6)

blocks: The baseline showed search finds the right moment far above chance but pins its edges poorly, last seen depends on the detectors cropping the object, and actions are the weakest area. Six changes were then chosen on set A and checked on a held-out set B; five were kept and one dropped.

sections.title: Approach

bullets: Academic licence, valid until 1 November 2026; data never in git (no redistribution).
Only the episodic-memory annotations (0.14 GB) and 24 validation clips (1.6 GB) were downloaded, to D:\eykon-cache\ego4d. The CLI prints the size and waits for yes, so nothing downloads unseen.

steps: From the 80 source videos that appear in all three tasks, take the 8 MQ clips with the most of our action labels.
From the same 7 source videos, take the 8 NLQ clips with the most questions and the 8 VQ clips with the most valid queries.

blocks: Set A: 24 clips, 177 minutes; 78 object + 12 people NLQ questions, 39 VQ queries, 100 MQ labels.

bullets: task ego4d-pipeline runs the phone's stages on the laptop with the phone's ONNX files and constants (3 fps, 9-frame slots, filters, dHash and MobileCLIP dedup, YOLOX-Tiny + D-FINE S + YOLOE-11L, place and action prompts, caption rule, object crops). 24 clips in 46.4 min, 4 at a time; 1,878 frames kept.
task ego4d-eval scores the result. **The scoring rules are written at the top of the script and were fixed before any score was read.**

blocks: 4 clips (27.8 min) were added through the app's own picker on the Pixel 9 Pro XL and compared with the laptop copy (task ego4d-phone-compare).

24 new validation clips from 5 other source videos (194 min), picked by the same rule (task ego4d-select -- B A). Every change was chosen on set A by a rule fixed in its script; set B was never used to choose anything, so only set B numbers are unbiased.

rows: object ever cropped by our detectors

sections.title: The phone run and parity (EYKO-56)
blocks: Frame choice, place and action carry over almost exactly, so the NLQ and MQ scores are the app's. Objects differ at the edges: the phone's hardware decoder and the laptop's FFmpeg give slightly different pixels, detector scores move by up to about 0.1, and objects near a cut-off appear on one side only.

rows: About 1.4 min per minute of video; YOLOE about half of it (2.5 s a frame)
About 7 MB for 27.8 min, with every vector
8.8 MB per minute, mostly dropped frames (fixed by EYKO-59)

sections.title: Six changes, chosen on A, checked on B

Run a laptop copy for accuracy, the real app on 4 clips for cost and parity

Choose on set A, report set B
